description: Defines mapping strategies for converting various 'thing' related events into JSON-serializable forms within the Eclipse Ditto project. It maps string event types to specific JsonifiableMapper implementations, facilitating serialization of different event types such as creation, modification, and deletion of 'things' and their attributes, features, policies, and ACL entries.

classes.name: ThingEventMappingStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that provides mapping strategies from event type strings to corresponding JsonifiableMapper instances for 'thing' events, enabling serialization and deserialization within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingEventMappingStrategies.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes the map of event type strings to JsonifiableMapper functions for all supported 'thing' event types.

methods.name: addTopLevelEvents
methods.description: Adds mappings for general 'thing' top-level events such as creation, modification, and deletion.

methods.name: addPolicyIdEvents
methods.description: Adds mappings for policy ID related events.

methods.name: addFeaturePropertyEvents
methods.description: Adds mappings for feature property related events, including created, modified, and deleted.

methods.name: addFeatureDefinitionEvents
methods.description: Adds mappings for feature definition related events.

methods.name: addFeatureEvents
methods.description: Adds mappings for feature related events.

methods.name: revisionFrom
methods.description: Extracts the revision number from an Adaptable payload, throws if missing.

methods.name: timestampFrom
methods.description: Extracts the timestamp from an Adaptable payload, returns null if not present.

methods.name: metadataFrom
methods.description: Extracts metadata from an Adaptable payload, returns null if not present.
